transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um, well, I guess I'm here because I've been having some trouble at work lately. I do hair, and... I don't know, my hands just feel like they’re moving through glue. Even basic things, like sectioning someone's hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever right now. It's actually becoming a problem because other people have started noticing that I’m just a lot slower than I used to be.
Have you noticed any shaking or tremors in your hands, or any involuntary movements that happen on their own?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My hands don't shake or move on their own or anything. They just feel really heavy and slow.
Have you noticed any stiffness or resistance in your muscles, like your arms or legs feel tight or hard to move?

No, I haven't really noticed any stiffness. Um, they don't feel tight or hard to bend or anything like that. It's really just that heavy feeling I mentioned... like it just takes a lot of effort to actually get them to move, but they aren't stiff.
Have you noticed any problems with coordination or balance, like bumping into things or dropping items more often than usual?

No, not really. I haven't been bumping into things or losing my balance. And I haven't been dropping my tools at work or anything. It's just the slowness, really. I still have control over what I'm doing, it just takes me a lot longer to do it.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even when you haven’t been doing much physically?

No, I wouldn't say I feel tired. Um, I have normal energy, I guess. I'm not feeling exhausted or needing to sleep more if I haven't been doing much. It's really just that heavy feeling I mentioned before when I try to do things at the salon or at home, but it's not like I'm actually out of energy or sleepy.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even outside of work?

Yeah, I have. Most days I wake up with this... this heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. It just feels like there’s no point in trying to build the life I was planning. Everything just feels hopeless.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities that you once looked forward to?

Yeah, I have. I used to really like chatting with my clients at the salon, and I'd always help out the newer stylists. Outside of work, I used to go hiking with my friends and actually look forward to it. But lately... I don't know, I just don't enjoy any of it. I mostly just keep my head down at work and avoid people as much as I can. I just don't have that spark in me anymore to do those things.

These symptoms are consistent with a diagnosis of a single episode of moderate depression (F32.1).
